name: tsla
schedule_note: 정시는 cron-job.org 반복 잡(시간대 America/New_York, 분 0과 30, 시 9부터 16, 월-금, body {job:tsla, oneoff_mode:auto}). 머지 후 cronjob-register.yml action=register_tsla 로 만든다. GitHub 백업 cron 은 */30 13-21 * * 1-5 (UTC). 이 창은 서머타임(13:30-20:00 UTC)과 표준시(14:30-21:00 UTC)를 둘 다 덮고, 스크립트가 뉴욕 시각 09:30-16:00 평일에만 판정한다. 09:00, 16:30, 늦게 도착한 백업은 그 문 밖에서 조용히 끝난다. job=tsla 수동 dispatch 는 oneoff_mode=auto 가 아니면 dry.
cron_approval_text: Check every 30 minutes during US regular market hours only (09:30-16:00 America/New_York, weekdays; handle DST correctly, e.g. by scheduling in UTC broadly and gating in code by NY time).
cron_where: GitHub backup: */30 13-21 * * 1-5. On time: cron-job.org timezone America/New_York, minutes [0,30], hours [9,10,11,12,13,14,15,16], wdays Mon-Fri, expires 2027-06-30 16:59:59 NY. Job id is filled in after action=register_tsla.
dedupe_note: state/tsla.json sent.s310 and sent.s300 store the America/New_York date already sent. Each stage at most once per NY date. A run at or under 300 sends only stage 2 and also marks stage 1 sent for that date, so the 310 notice does not follow later the same day. A 310 notice earlier the same day does not block a later 300 notice.
